title: GHSL AI agent helps find code injection in the vets-api workflow
product: U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs vets-api GitHub Actions
summary: The ready_for_review.yml workflow interpolated pull request branch data into shell commands in jobs with write-all permissions, enabling code execution through untrusted branch names.
ai_role: GHSL explicitly credits its AI agent and CodeQL jointly; it does not separate their contributions. Reported and fixed 2025-08-13. The advisory does not name a CVE.
classification_note: The advisory documents the issue and fix; it does not claim exploitation in the wild.
remediation_note: GHSL says the affected workflow was fixed on 2025-08-13. No released version or CVE is given.

impacts.conditions: A user-controlled pull request/workflow branch name is evaluated in shell commands in the affected GitHub Actions workflow, allowing code injection during those workflow runs.
impacts.exploitation: Exploitation in the wild is not established by the cited description.
